note: Reported FBXO11 cohorts present with neurodevelopmental and minor facial/skeletal anomalies while lacking major structural limb reductions and complex heart defects.

evidence.text: Across 12 individuals from 5 families with FBXO11 variants presenting with intellectual disability, gross structural congenital malformations were notably absent.

source.title: FBXO11 variants are associated with intellectual disability and variable clinical manifestation in Chinese affected individuals
source.quote: Distinguishingly, malformation was not observed in all the affected individuals.

evidence.text: In a series of 20 individuals with de novo FBXO11 variants, observed phenotypes were dominated by developmental delay, behavioral anomalies, cleft lip/palate, and minor skeletal anomalies rather than severe limb reductions or complex cardiac malformations.

source.title: De novo variants in the F-box protein FBXO11 in 20 individuals with a variable neurodevelopmental disorder
source.quote: behavioral problems (17/20), seizures (5/20), cleft lip or palate or bifid uvula (3/20), and minor skeletal anomalies.

numbers.metric: cleft lip or palate or bifid uvula
